cohort: Three women who underwent emergency transvaginal cervico-isthmic cerclage between 2009 and 2017
finding: Emergency transvaginal cervico-isthmic cerclage was effective in prolonging pregnancy in three women with prolapsed membranes at or beyond a dilated external cervical os before 24 weeks of gestation, resulting in an average gestational age of delivery of 38.5 weeks by caesarean section.
mod_finding: All three women in the study delivered by caesarean section.
gest_age: mean of 21.5 weeks at time of cerclage
